dimensions.assessment: Affects living Alaska Native veterans who served during the Vietnam era and their eligible heirs seeking land allotments up to 160 acres.
dimensions.evidence: extends for an additional five years the time period during which an eligible Alaska Native veteran may apply for a land allotment

dimensions.assessment: Allows eligible veterans or their heirs up to 160 acres of federal land in Alaska, providing a significant benefit to those who apply during the extended window.
dimensions.evidence: eligible to receive up to 160 acres of federal land in Alaska

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative processing of land applications by the Bureau of Land Management without stating specific new federal appropriations.
Amends an existing federal land allotment statute to change an application deadline.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1119(b)(3)(B) of the John D. Dingell, Jr. Conservation, Management, and Recreation Act... is amended by striking '5-year period' and inserting '10-year period'

dimensions.assessment: Extends the program's application window for a fixed period of five additional years (totaling a 10-year period).
dimensions.evidence: extends for an additional five years the time period... to December 29, 2030

missing_information: The exact number of eligible veterans or heirs who have not yet applied but will do so during the extension.
importance_detail.rationale: This enacted law extends the application period for the Alaska Native Vietnam Era Veterans Land Allotment Program by an additional five years, moving the deadline from December 29, 2025, to December 29, 2030.
